answer_1.quote: Automatic text summarization is the process of compressing a document while preserving key information content and meaning.

answer_2.quote: We evaluate our method using full-length F-1 ROUGE scores... All ROUGE numbers reported in this work have a 95% confidence interval of at most 0.24.

answer_4.quote: We performed a human evaluation using the same experimental setup as in... Each pair of (article, summary) is presented to three unique crowd workers, who are asked to judge the summaries along four criteria: Coherence (COH: does the summary make sense as a whole), Fluency (FLU: is it well written), Informativeness (INF: does the summary catch the most important points of the article), and Relevance (REL: are the facts in the summary consistent with the article).
answer_4.guideline: Crowd workers judge summaries based on coherence, fluency, informativeness, and relevance.
